title: Lead Nurture for Counselling Funnels
summary: Score and route enquiries from ads, forms and scholarship-test registrations, send consented WhatsApp and email follow-ups to parents and adult learners, and give counsellors a briefed call list.

seo.title: Lead Nurture for Admission Counselling | VipraTech
seo.description: AI lead scoring and consented WhatsApp nurture for coaching and university admissions, with counsellor call lists and no targeting of children.

problem.intro: Enquiries come from ads, website forms, seminars, school tie-ups and scholarship test registrations, and a family's decision can take weeks while they compare institutes and wait for board results. Counsellors call leads in the order they arrived, follow-ups depend on memory, and many registrants never sit the scholarship test they signed up for.

pain_points.title: Every lead treated the same
pain_points.detail: A parent who attended a seminar and asked about hostel fees gets the same call as a form filled in by mistake.

pain_points.title: Follow-ups fall through
pain_points.detail: Reminders for scholarship tests, results and counselling slots are sent by hand and inconsistently.

pain_points.title: Duplicate and messy records
pain_points.detail: The same family appears several times from different sources, with student and parent numbers mixed up.

pain_points.title: Compliance blind spots
pain_points.detail: Messages go directly to students under 18 without consent records, and promotional claims are not reviewed.

solution.overview: We build a nurture layer on top of your CRM. It merges duplicate enquiries, separates parent and student contacts, records consent and identifies leads that relate to minors, so communication goes to the parent or guardian. Leads are scored on signals you agree, such as class, target exam, programme asked about, source and replies, without behavioural profiling of children. High-intent families go to counsellors with a short brief of their questions so far; others receive approved WhatsApp and email sequences around scholarship tests, results and counselling slots. Your marketing head approves the content, and frequency caps apply.
capabilities: De-duplication and parent-student contact separation across lead sources
Consent capture and an age flag so under-18 communication goes to guardians
Transparent lead scoring on agreed signals that counsellors can see and override
Approved WhatsApp and email sequences for scholarship tests, results and counselling slots
Counsellor call lists with a brief of each family's questions and history
Outcome logging and source-level reporting for marketing spend decisions

workflow.title: Collect leads
workflow.detail: Enquiries arrive from ads, website forms, seminars, school tie-ups and test registrations.

workflow.title: Clean and check consent
workflow.detail: Duplicates are merged, parent and student contacts separated, and consent and age recorded.

workflow.title: Score and segment
workflow.detail: Each lead is scored on agreed signals and placed in a segment by class, exam and stage.

workflow.title: Route by intent
workflow.detail: High-intent leads become counsellor tasks with a brief; the rest join an approved nurture sequence.

workflow.title: Nurture and remind
workflow.detail: Guardians or adult learners receive scholarship test reminders, results and counselling slot invitations.

workflow.title: Log outcomes
workflow.detail: Counsellor calls, test attendance and admissions are written back to the CRM for reporting.

inputs: Enquiries from ad platforms, website forms and landing pages
Approved message content and programme details
outputs: De-duplicated lead records with consent and age flags
Lead scores with the signals behind them
Counsellor call lists with family briefs
human_in_the_loop: Counsellors decide how to advise each family, and the marketing head approves every sequence and message template. Scoring rules are reviewed with the admissions team, and counsellors can override any score.
integrations: CRM such as LeadSquared, Salesforce or Zoho
guardrails: No targeted advertising or behavioural profiling directed at children; under-18 leads handled through guardians
Consent recorded before any promotional message, and opt-outs honoured across channels
No claims about ranks, selections or results beyond verified, published data
Frequency caps per family and quiet hours
Every template approved before use and logged
compliance_notes: The DPDP Act 2023 restricts targeted advertising directed at children and requires verifiable parental consent to process their data.
Promotional SMS and calls must follow TRAI commercial communication rules, and WhatsApp templates must meet the platform's business messaging policies.
The Ministry of Education's 2024 coaching-centre guidelines discourage misleading claims about results.

pilot.scope: Leads for one programme or one scholarship test cycle, with your counselling team working from the new call lists.
deliverables: Lead data audit and de-duplication rules
Scoring rules agreed with the admissions team
Approved nurture sequences on WhatsApp and email
Pilot funnel report and roll-out plan

what_we_measure.how: Registrants who sat the test, compared with the previous comparable cycle.
High-intent leads contacted within the agreed time, from CRM timestamps.
Admissions traced back to lead source and segment.
Opt-out and complaint counts per sequence.

faqs.a: For learners under 18, communication goes to the parent or guardian, with consent. Adult learners, such as repeaters over 18, can be contacted directly once they have consented.
